localizedValues.name: Kopachuck Hall
localizedValues.description:
Reservations for the Kopachuck Hall are accepted up to one year in advance of the start date by emailing Kopachuck State Park at events.kopachuck@parks.wa.gov
This facility contains 3,639 square feet of heated and cooled interior space, including a large meeting area which can be separated into two rooms, audiovisual equipment, surround sound, and a stone and log hearth. The following smaller spaces are also included with this rental and can be accessed from the larger meeting room:
• Kitchen with a sink, full refrigerator, stainless steel counters, shelving, microwave, and a service window allowing direct service to the meeting space.
• Storage room with 20 10-person tables and 200 chairs, that can also serve as a separate changing area after the chairs and tables are removed.
• Four private single-stall bathrooms.
• Large patio accessible through bay doors.
• Outdoor power amp for one (1) food truck, space available for two (2) food trucks.
• Power outlets inside the hall and outside on the back patio.
Reservations cancelled at least 61 days before your arrival date will be charged a $10 cancellation fee. Cancellations made 60 days or fewer before your arrival date must pay the equivalent of the one-day fee.
